list.title: Trial batches
list.subtitle: Scale any saved version out to a manufacturing run. Locks against the frozen snapshot so future catalogue edits cannot rewrite the BOM.
list.empty: No trial batches yet — plan one to see the procurement BOM.
list.delete_confirm: Delete this trial batch? The underlying formulation version is not affected.

create.title: Plan batch — {formulation}
create.subtitle: Pick a saved formulation version. Kind, packaging combo, and run quantity are captured later on the Create Manufacturing Order modal — one place per decision, no duplicates.
create.approved_hint: Pre-selected the approved version (v{version}). Override only if you know you need a draft.
create.kind_trial_hint: Bench-scale test — no packaging combo. PSP MO bypasses Final Release and returns to R&D on QC pass.
create.kind_sample_hint: Customer-sample production with a picked packaging combo. PSP MO follows the full commercial release path.
create.packaging_none_hint: MO runs the recipe stages but skips packaging — the output is loose bulk (capsules in a bag, powder in a jar).
create.packaging_empty_hint: This formulation has no packaging combos defined yet. Add them on the Builder → Packaging tab if you want to run a packed sample.
create.batch_size_hint: Number of finished packs (bottles / pouches / tubs) the batch ships. Each pack contains the formulation's units-per-pack (e.g. 60 capsules), so entering 1 here builds one bottle of 60.
create.batch_size_unit_label: Batch size (individual capsules / tablets / gummies / scoops)
create.batch_size_unit_hint: Exact count of individual dosage-form units (capsules, tablets, scoops, gummies). No pack multiplier is applied.
create.quantity_moved_hint: Run quantity is captured later — when you click Create Manufacturing Order on the trial batch's page. The BOM view here renders the per-pack baseline recipe.
create.run_config_moved_hint: Kind (Trial or Sample), packaging combo, and run quantity are captured on the Create Manufacturing Order modal — pick them once, when you actually commit to producing the run. The BOM view here shows the per-pack baseline recipe.
create.label: Label
create.invalid_input: Pick a formulation version before planning the batch.

detail.scale_equation: {packs, plural, one {# pack} other {# packs}} of {perPack} {unitPlural} each = {total} {unitPlural} in total

column_hint.material: Raw-material name as it appears in the BOM.
column_hint.mg_per_unit: Milligrams of this raw material in one finished {unit}.
column_hint.g_per_pack: Grams of this raw material in one pack ({perPack} {unit}s per pack).
column_hint.bom: Grams of this raw material in 1 kg of finished blend. The weight column sums to exactly 1 000 g.
column_hint.kg_per_batch: Total grams (or count) needed for the whole batch run.
column_hint.actual: Empty column for the technician to write the actual weighed amount in pen — in grams.
